title: Ryot Slym Case W/ Smell Safe Technology
description:
Ryot Slym Case
The all new Slym Case from Ryot makes carrying all your essential vaping gear a breeze. The Slym Case features Ryots X-strap system which is perfect for securing all your smaller items. This case also has 2 more elastic straps that are helpful when securing larger items like a vaporizer. It is also possible to lock this case up through its lockable zip pulls. (Lock Not Included)
The SmellSafe Carbon Series incorporates extensive carbon fiber padding that both neutralizes and traps odors in its pores while our coated weather-proof fabric and moisture seal zipper provide a true physical barrier to keep odors in and the weather out. To re-activate the carbon lining filters, simply put in the dryer for 5 minutes.
Dimensions
Length – 15.2cm
Width – 7.6cm
Depth – 3.1cm
Included
1 x Slym Case
1 x Removable Pouch
